name: Data Breach Monitor (Have I Been Pwned) | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## Data Breach Monitor
Every Monday checks your team's email addresses against Have I Been Pwned. New breaches are logged with the kind of data exposed and what to do, the security contact gets a summary, and (optional) each affected person gets a short personal notice.
1. Get a Have I Been Pwned API key (haveibeenpwned.com/API/Key) and create a Header Auth credential: name `hibp-api-key`, value = the key. 2. Fill in **Settings** (one email per line). 3. Make a sheet with a **Breaches** tab (`breaches-sheet.csv`). 4. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail. 5. Activate.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Fill in these values before activating.

parameters.jsCode:
return [...new Set(String($('Settings').first().json.emails).split(/[\n,;]+/).map((e) => e.trim().toLowerCase()).filter((e) => /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(e)))]
  .map((email) => ({ json: { email }, pairedItem: { item: 0 } }));
